heading: Powers to make records of specified documents and copy records
content:
36C.
Powers to make records of specified documents and copy records
The Building Authority or a person authorized by the Building Authority
may—
(a)
make a record in the form of—
(i)
a paper document;
(ii)
a microfilm; or
(iii)
an electronic record,
of any specified document;
(b)
convert a record in the form of a paper document or a microfilm made under
paragraph (a) into an electronic record; or
(c)
make a copy of a record made under paragraph (a) or (b).
(Added 20 of 2008 s. 24)
